start: A member in a workout with a Plank set whose goal is 60 s

user_sees: A panel titled with the exercise, 'Countdown from 1:00. The set saves itself at zero.'
Big '1:00', buttons '−5 s' / 'Stopwatch' / '+5 s' (step size as set), and 'Start'
must_not: The clock already running before Start

user_sees: The clock counts down; the button reads 'Pause'; 'Stop and save 0:01' appears
must_not: The goal buttons still shown while running (the clock must not jump)

user_sees: A bell and a buzz; the set saved as 1:00 and ticked
must_not: The bell with no set saved

start: A member who wants to time a hold with no goal

user_sees: 'Stopwatch. Stop when you finish the set.' and the clock counting up

must_not: The set saved with the goal time instead

start: A member whose hand brushes the dimmed area while the timer runs at 0:42

steps.action: Touch the dark area above the panel
user_sees: Nothing changes; the clock keeps running
must_not: The panel closing and the 42 s lost

user_sees: 'Stop the timer?' with 'Keep 0:42', 'Discard' and 'Keep going'; the clock still running
The button faded and not pressable

start: A member at 'Stop the timer?' with the timer at 0:50

user_sees: The question goes; the clock carries on from where it is
The panel closes; the set stays unticked with no time

steps.action: Open the timer again on the same set
user_sees: A fresh clock at the goal, 'Start'
must_not: The old 0:50 or a paused state left over

start: Privacy and promise: a timed hold left open

steps.action: Leave the timer open for over an hour
user_sees: The workout is not paused as forgotten while the timer is open
must_not: The workout paused and back-dated during a timed set
